title: P1: Plain sigma exec hides why a requested MCP server offered no tools
detail:
`packages/sigma/src/exec.ts:264`

Run `sigma exec --mcp-server 'ghost=Never registered' 'hello'` in a home where `ghost` is unregistered. Plain exec prints the model's answer, emits no diagnostic and exits successfully. Sigma commits the reason in `sigma.mcp_unlisted`, but plain exec discards it. The caller cannot tell why the requested tool was unavailable.

Print the committed reason on stderr as a startup diagnostic. Keep the normal answer on stdout.
